research.searchCoverage: Official AccuLynx API v2, Bearer authentication, company/contact/lead/calendar endpoints, and dated incident search (AccuLynx + security breach/incident) reviewed on 2026-09-13. AccuLynx.com / ExactLogix is a US roofing-contractor CRM headquartered in Beloit, Wisconsin, with production host api.acculynx.com; this is not a mainland-China edition. Public coverage of the Verisk acquisition litigation is not a security incident. No qualifying AccuLynx platform incident was found in reviewed coverage, without a breach-free claim.
